title: The Cat Who Was Mayor For 20 Years
description:
Stubbs was a cat who served as the honorary mayor of Talkeetna, Alaska from 1997 until his death in 2017. He was named Stubbs because he had no tail. Stories say he was elected by write-in votes, but the town has no real mayor, so there was no election. His office was Nagley's General Store, he drank catnip water from a wine glass every afternoon, and he drew 30 to 40 tourists a day.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Stubbs (cat)'.

Would your cat make a good mayor? Tell us in the comments.
